property.comment: the number of times the test passed.

property.name: test_fail_count
property.comment: the number of times the test failed.

property.name: test_timeout_count
property.comment: the number of times the test timed out.

property.name: test_skip_count
property.comment: the number of times the test was skipped.

property.name: last_pass_build
property.comment: the last build number where this test passed.

property.name: last_fail_build
property.comment: the last build number where this test failed.

property.name: last_timeout_build
property.comment: the last build number where this test timed out.

property.name: last_skip_build
property.comment: the last build number where this test was skipped.

query.name: build-test-list
query.comment: Get the list of tests for a build
query.sql: SELECT grp.id AS id, grp.name AS grp_name, test.id AS tid, test.name AS test_name, test.total_pass_count AS pass_count, test.total_fail_count AS fail_count, test.total_timeout_count AS timeout_count, test.total_skip_count AS skip_count, COALESCE(test.last_pass_build, 0) AS pass_build, COALESCE(test.last_fail_build, 0) AS fail_build, COALESCE(test.last_timeout_build, 0) AS timeout_build, COALESCE(test.last_skip_build, 0) AS skip_build, run.duration AS duration, run.status AS status FROM porion_test_run_group AS rgrp INNER JOIN porion_test_group AS grp ON rgrp.group_id = grp.id INNER JOIN porion_test_run AS run ON run.group_id = rgrp.id INNER JOIN porion_test AS test ON run.test_id = test.id WHERE rgrp.build_id = :build_id ORDER BY grp.name, test.name

query.name: project-test-list
query.comment: Get the list of tests for a project
query.sql: SELECT grp.id AS id, grp.name AS grp_name, test.id AS tid, test.name AS test_name, test.total_pass_count AS pass_count, test.total_fail_count AS fail_count, test.total_timeout_count AS timeout_count, test.total_skip_count AS skip_count, COALESCE(test.last_pass_build, 0) AS pass_build, COALESCE(test.last_fail_build, 0) AS fail_build, COALESCE(test.last_timeout_build, 0) AS timeout_build, COALESCE(test.last_skip_build, 0) AS skip_build, COALESCE(run.duration, 0) AS duration, COALESCE(run.status, 1) AS status FROM porion_test_group AS grp INNER JOIN porion_test AS test ON grp.id = test.group_id LEFT JOIN porion_build AS build ON build.project_id = :project_id AND build.number = test.last_pass_build LEFT JOIN porion_test_run_group AS rgrp ON rgrp.group_id = test.group_id AND rgrp.build_id = build.id LEFT JOIN porion_test_run AS run ON run.test_id = test.id AND run.group_id = rgrp.id WHERE grp.project_id = :project_id ORDER BY grp.name, test.name
